title: Multimodal: a photo or a PDF reaches a tool

cards.title: A file as input to a tool
cards.text: A chat keeps a photo or a PDF, and a pack's tool has a model read it into a record.

cards.title: Prove the adapter first
cards.text: One test sends a made-up account as a JPEG and a PDF before anything is built on it.

cards.title: Bytes kept, checked
cards.text: Five kinds, 10 MB a file, 20 MB a chat, refused with the reason before a turn starts.

cards.title: The model sees a name
cards.text: One line names the file; the bytes go only to the tool, never into the conversation.

cards.title: A model handed in
cards.text: The catalogue gives each pack its model, wrapped once: traced, replayed, a tool row.

cards.title: Replayed by its bytes
cards.text: The same file answers from the recording; one byte different is a miss, never a paid call.
